meta.source: Designed from scratch for CoachPro (coaching / client-monitoring web app). References studied, not copied: SYRO, Tern, PulseClub.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas / page background. The warm paper ground the whole product sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default container: cards, panels, sheets, table body. Primary ground for `ink` text.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Subtle fill: table zebra rows, hover states, inactive segmented controls.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: progress tracks, wells, code/metric insets.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, sheets and drawers.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and default card borders. Decorative separation.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and emphasized separation. Meaningful boundary — holds 3:1 on `surface`/`bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines. On `surface`, `bg` and `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, column labels, supporting copy. On `surface` and `bg` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text still meeting body contrast (≥4.5:1). On `surface` and `bg`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders, disabled text. 3:1 only — use at 24px+/bold or for non-essential text, never for body copy.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverted `ink`-colored fills (e.g. the dark primary surface or ink buttons).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Signature vermilion: logo, primary actions, key accents, data highlights, large display graphics. Not for small text on light grounds — use `accent-text`.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed brand surfaces and dense brand accents. `ink-inverse` (light) / `on-brand` (dark) read on it at ≥3:1.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Faint vermilion wash: selected rows, highlighted cells, brand badge backgrounds.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Vermilion used AS text or links on `surface`/`bg`/tints (≥4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `brand` fills. Dark ink on vermilion — the editorial signature, ≥4.5:1 on `brand`.

tokens.name: pos
tokens.usage: "On track" / positive state indicator and dot. Teal (off the red–green axis) for color-vision safety — always paired with a label or icon.

tokens.name: pos-text
tokens.usage: "On track" text on `surface` and `pos-tint` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: pos-tint
tokens.usage: "On track" badge / cell background wash.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: "At risk" / caution indicator and dot. Always paired with a label or icon.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: "At risk" text on `surface` and `warn-tint` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: "At risk" badge / cell background wash.

tokens.name: neg
tokens.usage: "Off track" / missed / destructive indicator and dot. Reserved for negative states — brand vermilion never signals error. Always paired with a label or icon.

tokens.name: neg-text
tokens.usage: "Off track" / error text and destructive link labels (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: neg-tint
tokens.usage: "Off track" / error badge and cell background wash.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral informational accents and non-brand links/indicators.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Informational / non-brand link text (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring. Solid, 2px, with a 2px offset; ≥3:1 on every surface in both themes. Distinct from brand and status colors on purpose.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero headline. One or two words per line.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headlines on the site; empty-state titles in-app.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sub-section titles, dialog titles, list-group headers.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Dense titles: client name in a row, metric card label strong.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, onboarding and marketing body.
styles.sample: See how every client is progressing — without chasing spreadsheets.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI and content body text.
styles.sample: Logged 4 of 5 planned sessions this week.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary descriptions, helper text, dense tables.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text, tabs, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, badge text, table column headers (with `overline` casing when needed).

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: Hero KPI numbers on dashboards. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: metric-sm
styles.usage: Inline metrics inside rows and list items. Tabular figures.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and section kickers. Set in UPPERCASE in markup.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numeric data, units, IDs, timestamps, deltas. Tabular by nature.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Micro data labels on charts and axis ticks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, small gaps between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact control padding; gap inside list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding inside buttons and small cards; base rhythm unit.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (default); gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding; gap between stacked panels.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutters on tablet; large block separation.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Major section rhythm on the site.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and landing-section vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Top-level marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, small inputs, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Default cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards, modals, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, large media containers, the app-icon tile at scale.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, segmented controls, avatars, progress-ring caps.

shadow.note: Editorial and soft — elevation is carried mostly by borders and the paper ground. On dark, shadows deepen rather than disappear; pair with `border` for separation.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Raised cards, hovered interactive cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, sheets, command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdown menus, tooltips.
